newProjects.title: corn farm
newProjects.summary: Corn is one of the world's most resilient and powerful crops, grown on every continent except Antarctica. Far from just being a staple on our dinner plates, this ancient grain drives global supply chains, fuels vehicles, and acts as a key ingredient in everyday items ranging from cosmetics to biocomposites. However, growing corn successfully is a highly technical balancing act of timing, technology, and climate adaptation
